§6Quartz Crucible§f is the first machine in the silicon-processing pipeline. It melts quartz, sand, and other silicon-bearing materials into molten silicon at 1,800 degrees C.

The structure is a 3x3x3 hollow cube with Structure Towers on the corners. Use Liquid IO Circuit Boards on the inner faces to pipe fluid in and out. Feed molten silicon into a Crystallizer for automated wafer production.

§cWARNING:§f The crucible must heat up to operating temperature before melting begins, which can take several minutes. Also, never place water above it. A quench will damage the block.

§ePS:§f Power draw is 500 RF/t at idle, scaling with throughput. Plan your power supply accordingly.
